collection.title: Vauxhall Vivaro 2002 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Vivaro 2002 to 2014 model requires a 24" wiper blade for the drivers and a 21" on the passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Vivaro which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
